create_State_instance: create a State instance with invocation metadata, requests list, and requests closed flag for gRPC testing
send_response_with_State: send a response to a waiting client by calling send_response on a State instance
terminate_rpc_with_State: terminate an RPC call by calling terminate with trailing metadata, status code, and details
cancel_rpc_with_State: cancel an active RPC by calling cancel with a gRPC status code and error details string
take_request_from_State: take the next pending request from a State instance using take_request for server-side processing
